authorization_scopes.description: PORT-23 T1 GM1.10C Power-on supervision, watchdog, and sub-CPU handshake around StartDiskboot evidence scope (budget: at most 4 KiB per read, 64 KiB total)

evidence_entries.notes: Stock early boot 0xFC020000..0xFC0201FF: reset entry 0xFC02000C, vector copy 0xFC020016, High RAM copy 0xFC020024..36, full L1 D-cache clean 0xFC02003C, ATCM copy 0xFC020040..52, Low RAM copy 0xFC020054..66, Canon BSS zero loop 0xFC020068..78, branch to DryOS heap setup 0xFC02007A, and literal pool 0xFC0200B0..DF

Stock task_Startup (0xFC05B8FC) and startup task creator sub_fc05b962 (0xFC05B962): sub_fc05b962 calls sub_fc05ba68 (0xFC05B964), IsNormalCameraMode_FW (0xFC05B968), and power-on check sub_fc1284ac (0xFC05B96C); on zero return, calls sub_fc05ba56 (0xFC05BA56; writes GPIO 0x67=0x004C0003, cutting power) and hangs at 0xFC05B976. task_Startup calls StartDiskboot (0xFC05B90E), ErrColct (0xFC05B912), sub_fc418f2a (0xFC05B922; initializes hardware watchdog and starts task_WdtReset), and task_PhySw (0xFC05B92E)

StartDiskboot main sequence 0xFC05BBEA..0xFC05BDE9: SD write-protect GPIO check 0xFC05BC04; VBR BOOTDISK check 0xFC05BC18; sub_fc05bc3c at 0xFC05BC3C loading A/DISKBOOT.BIN; sub_fc54de38 validation 0xFC05BC62; reject path prints 'not executable' at 0xFC05BC68 and frees buffer; accept path invokes sub_fc0d9c9c at 0xFC05BC7A; literal pool strings '
StartDiskboot
', 'A/DISKBOOT.BIN', 'not executable
'

IsNormalCameraMode_FW (0xFC079404..0xFC079410) called by sub_fc05b962 at 0xFC05B968: loads byte from ROM pointer 0xFDF20380; if byte is 0 returns 1 (normal camera mode), otherwise returns 0; return value is passed in r0 to sub_fc1284ac to govern button-hold supervision check

Stock system continuation and TurnOffE1_FW sequence 0xFC0D0120..0xFC0D023F: TurnOffE1_FW entry at 0xFC0D01EC disables interrupts (0xFC0D01F2), stops hardware watchdog via sub_fc135d9a (0xFC0D01F6), calls sub_fc37c5c0 (0xFC0D01FA), loads action value 0x004C0003 from [0xFC0D0450], invokes GPIO_Write(pin=0x67) at 0xFC0D0202, and loops indefinitely at 0xFC0D0206 until power cut completes

GPIO write primitive sub_fc0d73c4 and read primitive sub_fc0d73d0: sub_fc0d73c4 maps pin index r0 to MMIO address 0xD20B0800 + (r0 * 4) and writes action value r1; pin 0x67 (103) maps to MMIO 0xD20B099C (power hold control); pin 33 maps to MMIO 0xD20B0884 (LED control). sub_fc0d73d0 reads GPIO pin state

Preparation for DISKBOOT payload handoff sub_fc0d9c9c (0xFC0D9C9C..0xFC0D9CCA): masks interrupts via blx 0xFC31BEFC (0xFC0D9CA2); invalidates D/I cache at 0x8000 via sub_fc41870c (0xFC0D9CAC); configures MPU region 7 via sub_fc135284 (0xFC0D9CB0); sets r0=0x4000, r3=0x8001; jumps to payload copy and execution veneer

Stock power-on button check sub_fc1284ac (0xFC1284AC..0xFC12851A): takes IsNormalCameraMode_FW in r0; samples GPIO 0x97 (Power button, 0xFC1284BC), GPIO 0x98 (Playback button, 0xFC1284C8), GPIO 0x88 (WiFi button, 0xFC1284DA), and GPIO 0x02 (0xFC1284EC); if in normal mode and all button states are unasserted (0), branches to 0xFC12851A returning 0, triggering shutdown via sub_fc05ba56; if any button is pressed, returns 1. 0xFC128524..0xFC1285AA diagnostic logger

WatchDog.c module 0xFC135C00..0xFC135E3F: WdtInt logger 0xFC135C14 ('

 !!!WatchDog expired!!! 

'); task_WdtPrint 0xFC135C3E; WdtInt interrupt handler 0xFC135C92; task_WdtReset 0xFC135CB0 (loops every 2000 ms via SleepTask(2000) writing 0xAA55 to *(0xD20A0004)); watchdog initialization sub_fc135ccc at 0xFC135CCC (configures *(0xD20A0000) = 0xC0000000 | (r1<<8) | (r0<<4), creates event flag, registers WdtInt interrupt 395, and spawns task_WdtReset and task_WdtPrint); StartWDT_FW 0xFC135D2C (enables bit 0 of *(0xD20A0000)); StopWDT_FW 0xFC135D68 (clears bit 0); sub_fc135d9a (watchdog disable helper called by TurnOffE1_FW); literal pool with MMIO pointer 0xD20A0000, RAM struct 0x0000C780, strings 'WdtInt', 'WdtReset', 'WdtPrint', 'WatchDog.c'

Watchdog startup function sub_fc418f2a (0xFC418F2A..0xFC418F7F) called by task_Startup at 0xFC05B922 (AFTER StartDiskboot): sets r0=2, r1=4, calls sub_fc135ccc at 0xFC418F34 to configure hardware watchdog *(0xD20A0000)=0xC0000420, and calls StartWDT_FW at 0xFC418F38 to activate watchdog bit 0
